evaluation_notes: Favor architectures that are operationally realistic for a small team and explicit about sync and conflict tradeoffs.
The strongest answer should separate the first implementation milestone from later scalability options.
expected_qualities: Produces a clear best-bet architecture plus a more conservative fallback.
Surfaces failure modes around state consistency, reproducibility, and local execution limits.

constraints: The first release must run locally on developer laptops.
State must stay replayable and inspectable with normal filesystem tools.
problem_spec.request: Design the best architecture for a local-first decision engine that orchestrates model calls, persists search state to disk, and needs a clean path to later sync across machines.
success_criteria: Keep the first milestone simple enough to ship in weeks.
Preserve a credible path to collaboration and replay later.

title: Local-first architecture for Argus-like systems
